lines.say: Battletoads was made brutally hard on purpose, so kids would buy it instead of renting it.
Rare created it in 1991, as their answer to the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles craze.
Rash and Zitz set out to rescue Pimple and Princess Angelica from the Dark Queen.
The Turbo Tunnel is one of the hardest levels on the NES.
In two player mode, you can hit your partner, and if one player runs out of lives, you both restart.
It won seven Nintendo Power Awards, and even got a cartoon pilot in 1992.
Did you ever get past the Turbo Tunnel? Follow for more 8-Bit Backstory!
